name: Partner wall organised by category
useWhen: A partner or technology roster has to show BREADTH across named categories, and which category a logo sits in matters as much as the logo being there.

focal.note: Deliberately low. No single logo is the point; the grid of them is. A hero logo here would break the claim that these are peers within a category.

replacesNote: logo-wall-v1 puts tiles in a fixed grid on the left half and leaves the right half empty. This is a table, not a grid, and it uses the canvas. Do not retire v1 until this has been through a real deck.

deviations.why: Logos are supplied per deck and inlined at fill time (§2a). Shipping a fixed set in the template would date it and bloat every deck that used it.
Same cause: 27 real logos are dense art, 27 text wordmarks are not. Re-measure on a filled deck before treating this as a composition defect.
